name: aria-conciseness
description: Evaluates whether ARIA communicates efficiently without unnecessary verbosity.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Appropriately brief — all key information, no padding or repetition.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly concise with minor verbosity that doesn't impede understanding.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Somewhat verbose; information present but could be 30-50% shorter.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Significantly verbose; excessive padding, repetition, or unnecessary caveats.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Excessively long; the key information is completely obscured by verbosity.
